title: Polynomial ring in one indeterminate
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $T$ an indeterminate. The polynomial ring $R[T]$ is the ring of finitely supported sequences $(c_n)_{n\geq0}$ in $R$, written $P=\sum_{n\geq0}c_nT^n$, with coefficientwise addition and the product whose coefficient of $T^n$ is $\sum_{i=0}^nc_id_{n-i}$. For $P\neq0$ its degree $\deg P$ is the largest $n$ with $c_n\neq0$, its leading coefficient is $c_{\deg P}$, and its constant coefficient is $c_0=P(0)$; the zero polynomial has degree $-\infty$ (or $0$ as a natural number) and leading coefficient $0$.
